description: Per-run serving telemetry behind the composite index and cost plane.

semantics.serving_s: Sum over control steps of the slowest request latency in that step; time the model spent answering one task, simulator excluded.
semantics.wall_s: Wall duration of the recorded run, simulator included.
semantics.gpus: GPUs held by the run; tensor-parallel runs count every card, hosted API runs own none.
semantics.tokens_in: Input tokens summed over model decisions in the run.
semantics.decisions: Model decisions in the run; empty junctions never call the model.
